title: From the exterior Fold field to compact-object and wave signatures
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

Exact exterior fields, compact-support endpoints and a complete inspiral–merger–ringdown sequence follow from generated Fold carriers.

Maria Smith derives the unique exterior clock-square coefficient, conserved inverse-square flux, the exact clock ratio 16/15 and quadrupole power 18 times amplitude squared. The paper develops stellar restoring exponents 5/3 and 4/3, terminal luminosity classes 3 and 4, finite tidal exhaustion, fourth-power exclusion support against sixth-power gravity, two pre-horizon families, quarter-area information and thermal-mass invariant 1/16.

The complete finite inspiral has falling separation and period, rising wave frequency and positive radiation takes, ends at actual horizon contact, joins two sources into one and continues through binary-damped ringdown at every finite depth. Full intermediate derivations, quantified input domains, exhaustive grammars and native Lean 4 proof references appear in the paper.

All original observations are retained: NIST/JILA atomic clocks, the Double Pulsar radiation correction vector, all six stellar luminosity intervals, galaxy and spin–orbit records, compact-object masses and conditions, and GW151226/GW190521 event values. The exact thermal law retains its explicit observational test. The source archive includes pinned V3/V4 code, full programme comparisons, build and zero-axiom audits, and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction.
